transcript.content: Hello. What brings you to the clinic today?

Honestly, doctor, I've been feeling this incredibly high, elevated mood but also getting extremely angry and irritable over the smallest things for the past eight months. I have this overflowing energy and hyperactivity where I just can't seem to sit still or stop doing things. It's like my mind and body are constantly running on overdrive.
Have these feelings of high energy and irritability been happening in distinct episodes that come and go, or have you felt this way constantly since childhood?

No, I definitely haven't felt this way since childhood; this is completely new for me. It has been happening continuously for about the last eight months without really stopping. It's just been one long, intense period of constant energy and irritability.
During this eight-month period, have you experienced things like hearing voices, seeing things others can't, or having strong beliefs that other people found unusual or untrue?

Yes, actually, during these past eight months I've heard voices and seen things that other people tell me aren't really there. I've also had some really strong beliefs that my family says are completely untrue, which has been so confusing. It all seemed to start around the same time I began feeling this intense energy.
Have you ever experienced these voices, visions, or unusual beliefs during a time when your mood was completely normal and you did not have that high energy?

No, I've never had those experiences when my mood was normal. They only seem to happen when I'm in this super high-energy, elevated state. When my mood is stable, all of those voices and visions completely stop.
